newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton settles lower, continues in range.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton settles lower, continues in range.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures settled lower as light speculative selling continued to chip away at recent gains, floor sources said.
The trade held the most-active July contract over support at 73.00 cents a lb as prices drifted within a narrow range.
July cotton settled 0.30 cent lower at 73.12 cents a lb, traded 73.45 to 73.00 cents. New-crop December went out down 0.11 cent at 75.65 cents.
Dealers said July will need to overcome 74.10 cents in order to attract fresh fund buying, but a lack of bullish fundamental news could keep the market in its recent sideways pattern.
An estimated 8,500 lots changed hands on the day, compared with Tuesday's official 8,904 lots.
